description: Interface definition for UploadedFileInterface in PSR HTTP Message standard, describing methods for handling uploaded files in HTTP requests.

classes.name: UploadedFileInterface
classes.description: Defines the contract for an uploaded file object, including methods to retrieve stream, move file, get size, error, filename, and media type.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns a stream representing the uploaded file, or throws an exception if unavailable.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.description: Moves the uploaded file to a specified location, ensuring the original is removed and handling multiple calls.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the uploaded file in bytes or null if unknown.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the upload error status, using PHP's UPLOAD_ERR_XXX constants.

methods.name: getClientFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename sent by the client, with caution about trusting this value.

methods.name: getClientMediaType
methods.description: Returns the media type sent by the client, with caution about trusting this value.
